back_story: 1986 was the year of excess: muscle cars, padded shoulders, wristwatches that told two time zones, and a skyline bought on credit. Vice City is that era distilled — cocaine economics, real-estate fever, and neon in three colors. Big cars, big hair, big dreams: the decade that burned brightest.
